**Most serious findings:**
1. **Payments under 15 Kč are a dead end.** An edit surcharge, a bike swap or a heavily discounted booking always goes to Stripe, which rejects it. Only the shop is checked on the server, and the app doesn't translate even that refusal. The customer sees raw English, or "Platba kartou zamítnuta", which is false. Retrying fails the same way. After 3 tries it promises "dokončit později", which is impossible for an edit.
2. **A bike taken meanwhile shows the wrong cause.** The database errors are in Czech ("Překrývající se rezervace…", branch closed), but the app only matches English text. So the customer gets "neznámá chyba… zkontrolujte připojení", with no "choose other dates or bike" option. I confirmed the Czech messages in the live database snapshot.
3. **SOS location sharing always says "Poloha sdílena"**, even when GPS was denied or the request failed.
4. **The offline screen covers the whole app**, including SOS, the phone line, navigation and ride recording. The forced-update dialog also has no SOS escape.
5. **Customers can pay twice in three places:**
   - After a late payment confirmation, the app goes to Rezervace, and the "Dokončit rezervaci" button offers a second payment.
   - On Android the card sheet can be swiped away mid-payment. iOS already guards against this.
   - In the shop, every retry creates a new order and a new charge.
6. **"No money was charged" is claimed when we don't know.** This happens on a 30-second timeout of the saved-card charge, and on an unexpected Stripe status.
7. **Saved-card errors lose their specific reason** (expired card, wrong CVC, 3-D Secure, below minimum). A failed or cancelled 3-D Secure shows a generic error and counts as a failed attempt.
8. **Screens with no way forward:**
   - the crash screen "Restartujte aplikaci" (no button)
   - the scanner camera error (raw exception, no settings or gallery option)
   - navigation with location denied (text only)
   - the profile and product error screens (no back)
   - unknown deep links (no custom error page)
9. **Raw technical errors reach customers** on Home, catalogue, reservation detail, edit, cancel ("Chyba storna: Chyba storna: PostgrestException…"), profile, password reset and scanner diagnostics. Several messages are always Czech (licence and overlap checks), and payment status shows as "UNPAID".
10. **Silent wrong answers:**
    - When availability can't load, the calendar shows every day free.
    - When offline, edit and restore say the bike is occupied ("obsazeno").
11. **Steps that can hang with no timeout:** creating the booking, saving the edit after payment, the AI assistant, SOS sending, shop order creation and 3-D Secure. The 30-minute payment timer also keeps running during an in-flight payment.
12. **Smaller gaps:**
    - Cancelling a booking shows no confirmation or refund amount.
    - "Zaznamenat jízdu" is buried in a menu, and one failure message covers four causes.
    - The success screen mixes vykání and tykání.

Prop sets covered: defaults, rank 1–20, reducedMotion true, and every enum option alone and with reducedMotion. Stavy also covered every skupina with varianta 1 and 32, plus pseudo, iOS and uk. - Rank × option fuzz: a lighter fuzzall (40–60 taps instead of 400) crossed every rank 1–20 with every enum and boolean option, plus a pairwise covering set. Rendering is deterministic except the Booking countdown. - HTML parser rules (parse2.py, static.py): tags are balanced, with no nested buttons or links, no block elements inside

, no self-closing non-void tags, no duplicate attributes and no duplicate ids after render. It also lacks the v2.2 surfaces, still uses the withdrawn full-screen offline overlay, closes the AI chat with a "×" glyph, and has none of the §7.11 fixes. Adversarial accessibility check of all 13 boards in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Vel-n/a6963cc3-5559-53b7-8eeb-5fd2cdb37dae/scratchpad/appdesign/project. No board was rendered or edited. A static CSS-cascade and contrast engine expanded each board through its renderVals (sc-if/sc-for/holes) and resolved the rank CSS variables per rk-N class, composited rgba/gradient layers and treated photos as the worst case. It ran 859 contrast states (all 20 ranks, every obrazovka/stav/ticketState/vrstva/stavDat/levelUp value, all 294 Stavy states), 876 animation and reduced-motion states and 648 focus/tap/name states. PASSED:
- All body, lead and meta text on white, canvas and well: meta #55705F is at least 4.94:1, lead at least 5.40:1, and there is no #6C8A7B or #7C958A text outside SOS.

- The focus-ring system fails broadly, because it depends on a hard-coded whitelist of dark containers.
